title: Calendar Filter – Class Section Dependency – SF Calendar – Class Section Not Accessible Without Course Selected
description: BR-15 — Decision Table (Breaking Change) — Confirms that on the SF Calendar, the class filter section is completely inaccessible when no course is selected, enforcing the new dependency.
preconditions: - Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org\n- SF Mana Calendar filter panel is open
steps_actions: 1. Open the SF Mana Calendar filter panel\n2. Do NOT select any course; observe the complete filter panel\n3. Scroll through the entire filter panel
steps_result: 1. Filter panel displays Course, Location, Teacher, and other filter sections\n2. No class filter section is visible; no class checkboxes, no class list, no "Class" label\n3. The class section is not present anywhere when no course is selected
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > Class Requires Course – Regression

title: Calendar Filter – Class Section Dependency – Course Deselected After Prior Use – Class Section Hidden Again
description: BR-15 — State Transition Testing — Confirms that after using the class filter (course selected, class checked), clearing the course causes the class section to become inaccessible again.
preconditions: - Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE\n- Course A has 3 classes; Group lessons G1–G4 exist in the current week\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
steps_actions:
1. On SF Mana Calendar, select "Course A – Introduction to Math"
2. Check Class Alpha
3. Deselect "Course A" from the Course filter
4. Observe the filter panel
5. Observe the calendar
steps_result:
1. Class section appears with 3 classes unchecked
2. Calendar is filtered; only Lesson G1 and Lesson G2 are shown
3. Course A is cleared
4. Class section is hidden; no class list, no class checkboxes visible
5. All lessons are shown (no course filter, no class filter active)
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > Class Requires Course – Regression

title: Calendar Filter – Regression – SF Calendar – Single Class Filter With Course Pre-Selection – Correct Lessons Shown
description: BR-15, BR-4 — Regression Analysis — Confirms that the single-class filtering behavior from LT-74136 still produces correct results using the new required flow: select course first, then check class.
preconditions:
- Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE
- "Course A" has 3 classes: Class Alpha, Class Beta, Class Gamma
- Group lessons: G1 (Class Alpha only), G2 (Class Alpha+Class Beta), G3 (Class Beta only), G4 (Class Gamma only)
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
steps_actions: 1. On SF Mana Calendar, select "Course A – Introduction to Math" in the Course filter\n2. Check Class Alpha in the class filter\n3. Observe which lessons appear on the calendar
steps_result: 1. Class section appears with all 3 classes unchecked\n2. Class Alpha checkbox is checked (active)\n3. Lesson G1 and Lesson G2 are shown; Lesson G3 (Class Beta only) and Lesson G4 (Class Gamma only) are hidden
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > Class Requires Course – Regression
